remote.name: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
remote.free_tier: Gemini Developer API (API key from AI Studio): Standard tier is listed as "Free of charge" for both 3.8 TTS models; only an active project is needed, no credit card (a card is needed only for the paid Tier 1). Exact free-tier rate limit: UNVERIFIED (shown only in the AI Studio console). Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Vertex AI / Google Cloud: NO free tier for Gemini TTS; billing must be enabled; the $300 welcome credit cannot be used for Vertex AI Gemini services on accounts created or upgraded on or after 2026-11-16.
remote.paid: Flash TTS $0.50 per 1M input tokens and $9.00 per 1M audio output tokens (about $0.00225 per 10 s of audio) through 2026-12-31, doubling from 2027-01-01. Flash-Lite TTS $0.50 / $6.00, doubling too. Audio is 25 tokens per second. Batch/Flex half price, paid only.
remote.needs: Developer API: a Gemini API key (set in the plugin settings, never in chat). Vertex: a Cloud project with billing and the Hermes Google sign-in.
remote.caveats: Rates are temporary promotional rates until 2026-12-31. Developer API and Vertex use different request schemas and voice namespaces.

remote.name: Inworld TTS
remote.free_tier: On-Demand plan costs $0 and lists "Up to 70 min TTS included". Whether the 70 minutes is one-time or monthly: UNVERIFIED. Card requirement: the plan table shows payment "Not included" for On-Demand (inferred no card; not stated outright).
remote.paid: On-Demand: TTS-2 $25 per 1M characters, TTS-2 Flash $15 per 1M. Subscriptions lower the rate (Creator $25/mo: $20 and $10 per 1M).
remote.needs: An Inworld account and API credential (Base64 string from the portal), set in the plugin settings.
remote.caveats: The terms grant Inworld a licence to inputs and outputs to operate and improve the service. Per-minute rate limits: UNVERIFIED (docs page needs a login). 2,000-character request cap.

remote.name: ElevenLabs
remote.free_tier: Free plan: $0, 10,000 credits per month, no rollover, 2 to 4 concurrent requests. Credits per character: UNVERIFIED. Card requirement: UNVERIFIED. NOT allowed for commercial use on the free plan, and published audio must be attributed to elevenlabs.io.
remote.paid: API list prices per 1K characters: v4 $0.08, v4 Turbo $0.04, v3 $0.08, v2 Multilingual $0.08, Flash/Turbo $0.04. Starter $6/mo for 30k credits (commercial licence starts here), Creator $22/mo for 121k.
remote.needs: An ElevenLabs API key, set in the plugin settings.
remote.caveats: The pricing page carried an inconsistent expired-looking promotion banner; ignore the $1 first-month offer. PageCast notes the default voices are scheduled for retirement on 2026-12-31.

servers.name: Ollama
servers.platforms: macOS confirmed for speech; Linux and Windows confirmed for the LFM3 audio models (Phonon there: UNVERIFIED)
servers.openai_style: yes: POST /v1/audio/speech (model, input up to 4096 chars, voice, response_format wav or pcm only; speed only 1; instructions rejected)
servers.status: active; speech endpoint merged 2026-10-22, so very new

servers.name: llama.cpp (llama-tts, llama-server)
servers.platforms: anywhere llama.cpp builds: CPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan
servers.install: release binary or build; llama-tts -hf ggml-org/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base-GGUF -p "Hello" --output out.wav
servers.openai_style: yes with limits: POST /v1/audio/speech, wav or pcm only, speed 1.0 only, voice names like alloy not mapped; cloning through the extra field speaker_ref_b64
servers.cloning: yes via speaker_ref_b64; the README recommends always giving a reference voice

servers.name: vLLM-Omni
servers.platforms: NVIDIA CUDA (NPU mentioned); Docker nightly images
servers.openai_style: yes: POST /v1/audio/speech (input, voice, response_format wav/mp3/flac/pcm/opus, plus language, task_type, stream)
servers.cloning: yes: ref_audio plus ref_text in the same request
